svg.text: WS2812B 8×32 matrix · Pro Micro 5 V (ATmega32U4) · separate 5 V supply
WS2812B 8 × 32 panel (input end on the left)
optional: also feed the far end (red/black leads) when running bright
330 Ω in the data line, close to DIN
1000 µF (≥ 6.3 V) across the supply, at the panel
One common ground: supply, panel and board
Panel power from the supply, never from the board's USB 5 V
3.3 V board (ESP32): 74AHCT125 level shifter before DIN
Brightness is capped at 15 % in software and 2.5 A in the sketch; full white on 256 LEDs would draw about 15 A.
